services.headerSubtitle: Three sectors, one vision: protecting talent and empowering lawyers.

law.title: Sports Law
law.desc: We provide specialized legal consulting for players, clubs, and lawyers. We review contracts, ensure FIFA and CAS compliance, and run the 'Case Radar' that detects potential disputes before they happen.
law.note: We operate as Scouting & Consulting. For official negotiations, we partner with a licensed FIFA agent.

football.title: Women's Football
football.desc: We scout young talent in Africa (WAFCON, U20 tournaments) and match them with clubs in the Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE) and Korea. We focus on local players, under 23, without agents.

esports.title: Esports
esports.desc: We manage talent and teams in the African competitive scene (eFootball, Rocket League, MLBB). We organize tournaments and connect players with clubs and sponsors.

about.headerSubtitle: A hybrid sports law agency combining law, data, and AI.
